title: Ground-Truth, Whose Truth? - Examining the Challenges with Annotating Toxic Text Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the influence of individual annotators and annotator imbalance on final ground-truth labels by analyzing the distribution of annotations and comparing multi-label (context-aware) annotation agreement with external machine learning models.

Analyzing the opposition rate to final ground-truth labels across different annotator racial demographic groups (White, Hispanic, Asian, Black, Native) using data statements from the SBIC dataset to determine if minority annotators disagree more frequently with majority-driven labels.

Re-annotating text samples using an 'inferred group label' to evaluate whether the perceived offensiveness of a text changes depending on whether the hypothetical author of the text belongs to the targeted demographic group (e.g., Muslims, Black people, women).
